## Description
A 15 kW Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) stack comprises &#10;&#9;&#9;    75 fuel cells, furnished with valves, coolant and pump, filter, sensors,&#10;&#9;&#9;    cold plate and heat pipes. &#10;&#9;&#9;
